Newsprint is made from the wood of fast-growing fir trees.
There are four stages to make newsprint:
•
Cut down the tree.
•
Saw off the branches to leave the trunk.
•
Grind down the trunk to make wood pulp.
•
Turn the wood pulp into newsprint.
